unsupported_claims: It was singled out as the representative edge-feature operator in the main results (the evidence does not say this).
rationale: The evidence supports that the Hadamard operator with node2vec gave the best average performance across all networks. It also supports that this was in link prediction. The claim that it was singled out as the representative operator in the main results is an invented detail, and the evidence does not mention it. Element-wise product is the standard definition of the Hadamard operator, so that part is background.
